correctness.rationale: The even-moment Gram inverse generates the explicit five-degree-denominator quartic coefficient h_{m,k} and reproduces degrees 0–4. Discrete differences commute with convolution; an input step has delta difference so the exact unanchored variation operator norm equals G_m=sum|h_{m,k}|, not merely an upper bound. Independently recomputed all integer gains m=2..1999 with exact rational arithmetic: unique maximum at m=6, G_6=3763/2431. For m>=2000 the paper gives a uniform coefficient difference <34/m relative to K(u)=(225-1050u²+945u⁴)/128 and BV Riemann-sum discrepancy <9/m; hence G_m<G_infinity+78/m. Rational root brackets and polynomial integration prove G_infinity<301/200, and 301/200+78/2000<3763/2431. This analytical tail, not finite enumeration or a floating-point limit, closes the infinite quantifier. The degree-five center intercept equals quartic by odd/even orthogonality.
